spinner: A drafting compass at work: around a centre mark and a faint dashed construction circle, the cyan line is drawn once round at constant speed, lifted off and drawn again.
skeleton: A section hatch between two dimension ticks, drawn left to right at the pen's constant speed, line after line: the drawing of a line that is not there yet.
switch: An outline drawing: a hollow square thumb with its centre lines; on, the slot is section-hatched and the thumb is filled cyan.
check: The tick is drawn at the pen's constant speed; the radio becomes a registration mark, a dot crossed by centre lines that run past the circle.
toast: A mono note whose width is dimensioned above it: the outline is drawn left to right, then the dimension line spans out to its two end ticks.
dialog: A sheet on grid paper with registration crosses at two corners, its outline drawn along the top edge first and then down.
tooltip: A drawing annotation in the red-pencil amber: the leader line with its node runs up to the button first, then the label is drawn out.
steps: A chain of dimensions: numbered 01 to 04 in mono, joined by tick-ended dimension lines, done ones cyan, the current one ringed in amber.
empty: A blank sheet of grid paper with a dashed outline and only the centre mark of a part not drawn yet.
link: A hairline underline; under the pointer it gains end ticks and the word becomes a measured length.
